description: Harua Well-Ageing Day and Night Cream Combo Pack | Encapsulated Retinol, Peptide + Myoline, 45g Night + 20g Day, Renew Smooth Firm, Plump Protect Glow - Distributed/Packaged by Harua. Product Details: Introducing the Harua Well-Ageing Day and Night Cream Combo Pack — a complete skincare duo designed to work around the clock for visibly younger-looking skin. The set includes the Encapsulated Retinol Well-Ageing Night Cream (45 g) and the Peptide + Myoline Well-Ageing Day Cream (20 g travel pack), making it ideal for both your daily routine and on-the-go use. The night cream harnesses the power of encapsulated retinol to renew, smooth, and firm your skin as you sleep, helping to reduce the appearance of fine lines and uneven texture overnight. The day cream, enriched with peptides and myoline, works to plump, protect, and impart a healthy glow throughout the day, keeping your skin looking supple and radiant. Together, these two formulations complement each other beautifully, offering a well-rounded approach to ageing gracefully. Whether you are new to a well-ageing routine or looking to upgrade your existing regimen, this combo pack from Harua delivers targeted care morning and night for skin that feels nourished, firm, and luminous.
